rationale: Create one canonical Mantle Reach Power company. Direct company, manager and transaction-party sources establish a current EnCap Energy Transition Fund III-backed geothermal independent power producer with a North American mandate. Preserve Mantle Reach as an alias and the manager's reported 2023 initial-investment year only as qualified history; do not infer a 2023 Fund III entry, ownership percentage or holding vehicle because continuity into the current LLC is not publicly established.

Baker Hughes identifies Mantle Reach as an EnCap Energy Transition Fund III company
The commercial agreement targets up to 500 MW over five years

afterImage.name: Mantle Reach Power
afterImage.description: Mantle Reach Power LLC is a geothermal independent power producer that develops, finances, owns and operates generation projects intended to provide firm, around-the-clock carbon-free power across North America. Target end markets include electric utilities, industrial users and large loads such as AI and hyperscale data centers. The company is backed by EnCap Energy Transition Fund III and in June 2026 announced a Baker Hughes agreement targeting up to 500 MW over five years; current commissioned, operating and development capacity is not publicly disclosed. EnCap reports a 2023 initial investment under the Mantle Reach name, but public evidence does not establish the original fund, vehicle or legal continuity into the current 2026 geothermal LLC, so no entry year or stake is inferred for the active Fund III ownership period. No sale, exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.

milestones.event: EnCap reports making an initial investment under the Mantle Reach name; the original fund, vehicle and continuity into the current LLC are not publicly disclosed.
Mantle Reach Power LLC emerged publicly as an EnCap-backed geothermal independent power producer developing, owning and operating projects across North America.
Mantle Reach Power and Baker Hughes announced a strategic agreement targeting development of up to 500 MW of geothermal generation across North America over five years.
